item.title: Clearer delete-account confirmation
item.summary: The phrase you have to type to delete your account now reads as a distinct value instead of repeating itself inside the empty field, and when deletion is waiting on provider access, each named provider links to its own site.
item.details: Removing Murph's access happens in the provider's account, not in Murph, so the confirmation checkbox and the exact typed phrase still gate the retry.
